description: This source file provides a helper function to resolve URLs for specific authentication-related API endpoints in a frontend application, specifically overriding certain endpoints to route to an external domain. It includes logic to normalize input URLs, check against predefined override patterns, and construct the appropriate URL accordingly.

methods.name: resolveAuthEndpointUrl(path, baseUrl)
methods.description: Resolves a full URL for authentication endpoints, overriding certain paths to route to an external domain based on pattern matching.
